spans.s:
m. (-पः)
1 Wrath, rage.
2 Morbid irritation or disorder of the humours.
E.
कुप to be angry, affix घञ्.

m. (-मः)
An angry or passionate man.
E.
कोप rage, and क्रम who goes or has.
n. (-मं)
The creation by BRAHMĀ.
E.
क BRAHMĀ, and उपक्रम order, method; also similar compounds, as कोपज्ञ, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Enraged, inflamed with wrath.
E.
कोप, and ज्वलित inflamed.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Incensed, inflamed with anger.
E.
कोप, and दीप्त shining.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Passionate, wrathful.
f. (-ना)
A passionate woman.
E.
कुप to be angry, युच् affix, fem. affix टाप्.

n. (-दं)
Appearance of anger, pretended wrath.
E.
कोप, and पद place.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Passionate, angry.
E.
कोप, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-गः)
Violence, impetuosity of passion.
E.
कोप, and वेग speed.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Furious, enraged.
E.
कोप, and आकुल bewildered.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Angry, enraged.
E.
कोप, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Angry, passionate, wrathful.
m. (-पी)
A bird called the water-pigeon.
E.
कुप to be angry, णिनि aff.
